journey.proof: REAL day transition: energy 97->100, growthDays 0->1, stage 0->1, watered consumed

receiptSequence: 1..7 strictly increasing — every action produced its own new receipt, so no beat passed on a stale one

rootCauseFound.symptom: After sleeping, the next farm action produced NO receipt at all (sequence frozen at the bed action value), so beats failed with empty farmAttempts.
rootCauseFound.cause: src/player/input.ts injectActionEdge() synthesizes an Enter keydown/keyup. The sleep beat closes the bed dialogue with Enter (pressUntil), and the engine deliberately clears any unconsumed action edge on interpreter enter/exit to avoid double-triggering. The immediately following farm action edge was flushed with it.
rootCauseFound.verdict: Correct engine behavior, NOT a product defect. The scenario had to let the interpreter fully exit before injecting the next action edge.
rootCauseFound.fix: pauseFrames -> stepFrames(30) to drain the interpreter -> action -> stepFrames(16) -> resumeFrames.

refutedHypotheses: forage placeable intercepting the tile — refuted: placeablesAt (4,6) was null
stale receipt misread as a new result — confirmed as a reading error via sequence numbers
post-sleep input gating — refuted: the bed action right after DID register (seq incremented)
pauseFrames incompatibility — refuted: reordering action outside the pause reproduced identically
observe:true observed action — reverted: performObservedAction waits on a wall-clock deadline without stepping frames, so it deadlocks with pauseFrames and broke three previously passing beats
